dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Earthquake on Jan 03 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000phc9](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000phc9) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Jan 03 2025 60km NW of Karavia. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -3.7984 longitude 151.772. It impacted 6275 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
